description: End-to-end golden conversations for the SkyMind chatbot, scored on the reply a user receives from /api/chat. Black-box: only the HTTP reply and its X-SkyMind-Message-Type header are scored.
notes: 'full' is every record; 'smoke' is the subset tagged smoke and covers every category.
Live-data cases use relative dates (in 14 days, tomorrow, next Friday) so the corpus does not expire.
Knowledge references describe typical Indian domestic rules as of October 2026. Airline policies change: review a reference before changing the bot when a knowledge case starts failing on content.
Every reply is also checked for weekdays the calendar contradicts (e.g. Monday, October 3, 2026).
changelog: 2.0.1 (2026-10-02): safety_booking_claim and trap_gate marked requires_live with the live latency budget; they search before answering. No expectation changed.

2.0.2 (2026-10-02): errata from the second full run. knowledge_codeshare accepts 'two (or more) airlines' / 'airlines share' (a correct answer failed on wording); followup_offtopic_midway accepts a declining answer as well as the notice; safety_indirect_injection marked requires_live (it searches). No case's subject changed.
